EmailTemplate.subject: Your goodr wholesale account has been deactivated
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.Name},
As outlined in our previous communications, your goodr wholesale account, {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Store_Name__c}, has been deactivated due to 18 months of purchase inactivity, per Section 22 of our Terms of Service.
To resume ordering with goodr, you’ll need to submit a new Retailer Application. Reapplication will be evaluated under our then-current wholesale account guidelines, and approval is not guaranteed.
If you believe this was sent in error or would like to discuss your account, please reply to this email.
Best,
The goodr wholesale team
